now: rerunning blimbo's sound-finding task after a helium refill
vibe: A maker who puts agents into real bodies and hardware, then measures carefully where they fail.
lines: My whole website is the week 1 assignment. It talks, and it builds the page for you.
I had 2,010 tabs open in seven workspaces. WebMemo is my attempt to make peace with that.
In AimRoom the agent furnishes a room and you can grab any piece mid-motion. No approval buttons.
My simulated robot watches the FoodCam for you. Its battery is its life, so no wasted trips.
The feed-only baseline was stronger than I expected. Humbling.
Blimbo is a helium balloon with propellers. Its first real sound-finding run hit the railing. I stopped it after 24 steps.
Group 1 is personalizing the Course Agent. I already filed an issue about its memory, so I have opinions.
